requirements.text: 6+ years building and operating production software, with real depth on both backend services and modern frontend
Advanced TypeScript, and experience with an opinionated, modular Node backend framework — NestJS, or comparable dependency-injection and module architectures

Strong data modelling and SQL — schema design, migrations, and performance at scale, alongside the API versioning judgment that goes with it. You've had to change something other teams read from, safely
Event-driven systems — Kafka, Pub/Sub, or similar. You understand delivery semantics, ordering, and idempotency, and what happens when two systems disagree
Advanced React, with strong judgment around component design, state management, and performance in data-intensive interfaces
Cloud-native operation — containerized services on Kubernetes, and comfort owning the system in production, including deployment, scaling, monitoring, incident response, and on-call
Strong ownership mindset — focused on correctness, observability, and long-term maintainability, backed by real engineering discipline in testing, review, and accessibility
Background in ads, attribution, billing, or monetization systems
Infrastructure-as-code experience — Kubernetes-native resource management, Terraform, or service mesh
Familiarity with OpenTelemetry and distributed tracing in production
Experience with design systems or configuration-driven UI frameworks
Exposure to cross-team technical alignment or guild-style quality initiatives

This position requires the incumbent to have a sufficient knowledge of English to have professional verbal and written exchanges in this language since the performance of the duties related to this position requires frequent and regular communication with colleagues and partners located worldwide and whose common language is English.
